title: Fiber / HTTP Route
description: Traffic, errors, latency and payload sizes of a single Fiber route.

list.name: prefix
list.label: Metric prefix
list.description: Namespace and Subsystem the middleware was configured with, joined by an underscore. "http" unless Config.Namespace or Config.Subsystem were changed.

list.name: service
list.label: Service
list.description: The service label set through Config.ServiceName. Empty when it is not configured.

list.name: path
list.label: Route
list.description: Registered route pattern, as Fiber matched it.

panels.title: Request rate
panels.description: Requests per second across the selection, from requests_total.

targets.expr: sum(rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: 5xx errors
panels.description: Share of this route's requests answered with a 5xx status.

targets.expr:
(
  sum(rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method", status_code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval]))
  or
  sum(rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0
)
/
sum(rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: 4xx errors
panels.description: Share of this route's requests answered with a 4xx status.

targets.expr:
(
  sum(rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method", status_code=~"4.."}[$__rate_interval]))
  or
  sum(rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0
)
/
sum(rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Latency p50
panels.description: p50 of request duration over the last rate interval, from request_duration_seconds.

targets.expr:
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])))
or
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum(rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Latency p95
panels.description: p95 of request duration over the last rate interval, from request_duration_seconds.

targets.expr:
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])))
or
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Latency p99
panels.description: p99 of request duration over the last rate interval, from request_duration_seconds.

targets.expr:
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])))
or
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Requests by status class
panels.description: Request rate stacked by status class. The class is derived from status_code, so this panel works with requests_status_class_total disabled.

targets.expr: sum by (status_class) (label_replace(rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval]), "status_class", "${1}xx", "status_code", "(.).."))
sum by (status_code) (rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Error ratio
panels.description: Share of requests answered with a 5xx (server errors) or a 4xx (client errors).

targets.expr:
(
  sum(rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method", status_code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval]))
  or
  sum(rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0
)
/
sum(rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval]))

(
  sum(rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method", status_code=~"4.."}[$__rate_interval]))
  or
  sum(rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0
)
/
sum(rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Latency percentiles
panels.description: Request duration percentiles for this route. Trace exemplars are shown on p99 when Prometheus stores them and the request carried a sampled span.

targets.expr:
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])))
or
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum(rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])))
or
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])))
or
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Latency distribution
panels.description: Requests per second by duration bucket.

targets.expr:
sum by (le) (rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval]))
or
(
  sum(rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval]))
  unless on ()
  sum by (le) (rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval]))
)

panels.title: p95 latency by status code
panels.description: Fast failures and slow timeouts look alike in the overall percentiles; split by status they do not.

targets.expr:
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, status_code) (rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])))
or
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (status_code) (rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Request size percentiles
panels.description: Percentiles of the request body size, from request_size_bytes. Requests without a body, such as most GETs, record zero; bodies of unknown length are left out.

targets.expr:
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(${prefix}_request_size_bytes_bucket{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])))
or
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum(rate(${prefix}_request_size_bytes{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(${prefix}_request_size_bytes_bucket{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])))
or
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(${prefix}_request_size_bytes{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(${prefix}_request_size_bytes_bucket{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])))
or
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(${prefix}_request_size_bytes{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Response size percentiles
panels.description: Percentiles of the response body size, from response_size_bytes. Responses that carry no body (HEAD, 1xx, 204, 304) record zero; streams of unknown length are left out.

targets.expr:
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(${prefix}_response_size_bytes_bucket{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])))
or
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum(rate(${prefix}_response_size_bytes{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(${prefix}_response_size_bytes_bucket{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])))
or
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(${prefix}_response_size_bytes{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(${prefix}_response_size_bytes_bucket{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])))
or
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(${prefix}_response_size_bytes{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Payload throughput
panels.description: Body bytes per second received in requests and sent in responses, from the size histograms. Headers are not counted, and payloads of unknown length (an unannounced stream) are left out — see the prometheus middleware README.

targets.expr:
sum(rate(${prefix}_request_size_bytes_sum{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval]))
or
histogram_sum(sum(rate(${prefix}_request_size_bytes{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])))

sum(rate(${prefix}_response_size_bytes_sum{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval]))
or
histogram_sum(sum(rate(${prefix}_response_size_bytes{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Requests by instance
panels.description: Request rate per instance for this route.

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval]))

(
  sum by (instance) (rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method", status_code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval]))
  or
  sum by (instance) (rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0
)
/
sum by (instance) (rate(${prefix}_requests_total{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval]))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, instance) (rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])))
or
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (instance) (rate(${prefix}_request_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", path="$path", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])))
